preview page retains row-number cursor and refuses a mixed generation
only committed state says committed; processing and failures are distinct
status cursor and mappings send exact current backend contracts
lost commit reply survives remount and retries original digest/default/version/key
CSV report downloads server bytes with same-origin credentials and refuses HTML success
workbook status labels cannot select inherited object keys as mappings
receipt attribution uses backend facts and never invents the current viewer
prototype-like source status is encoded as mappingEntries, not stripped record keys
settings/board/column values and baseline refs survive query cache clearing and route recreation
actual selected File blob stays only in actor/target memory and retains exact workbook bytes
stored draft warning remains after subscribers unmount until explicit discard/save clears it
every new sign-in state has plain copy that follows the style guide
unknown or crafted states show nothing, so a link cannot put words on the page
unsaved text is tracked and announced to subscribers
